decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Let me analyze the opponent's team and decide which 3 Pokémon to bring.

Opponent's team: rotomwash, mimikyu, kingambit, gholdengo, dragapult, ceruledge

Key threats:
- Kingambit: Dark/Steel, physical attacker, very strong. Weak to Fighting, Ground, Fire.
- Gholdengo: Steel/Ghost, special attacker. Weak to Fighting, Ground, Fire.
- Dragapult: Dragon/Ghost, very fast. Weak to Ghost, Dark, Ice, Dragon, Fairy.
- Ceruledge: Fire/Ghost, physical attacker. Weak to Water, Rock, Ground, Ghost, Dark.
- Mimikyu: Ghost/Fairy, physical attacker. Weak to Ghost, Steel, Poison, Ground.
- Rotom-Wash: Electric/Water, bulky. Weak to Grass, Ground.

My options:
- Gholdengo: Steel/Ghost special attacker. Good against Mimikyu (resists Fairy, hits with Steel), Kingambit (resists Dark, hits with Steel). Weak to Fighting, Ground. Speed ties with their Gholdengo potentially.
- Corviknight: Flying/Steel tank. Good defensive pivot, resists many types. Can Defog.
- Arcanine-Hisui: Fire/Rock physical attacker with Chople Berry (resists Fighting). Head Smash is 150 BP. Very strong against Kingambit, Gholdengo, Ceruledge, Mimikyu. Weak to Water, Ground, Fighting (but Chople Berry helps).
- Rotom-Wash: Electric/Water bulky. Will-O-Wisp is great against physical attackers. Good against Kingambit (resists Dark, Water hits Steel), Ceruledge (Water hits Fire).
- Clefable: Fairy special attacker with Calm Mind. Good against Dragon types (Dragapult), Kingambit (resists Dark). But weak to Steel (Gholdengo, Kingambit).
- Dragapult: Dragon/Ghost very fast. Good against Gholdengo (Ghost hits), Kingambit (Dragon hits), Mimikyu (Ghost hits). But weak to Ice, Dragon, Fairy, Dark.

Let me think about coverage:

Arcanine-Hisui is incredibly powerful with Head Smash. It hits Kingambit super effectively (Rock > Dark/Steel), Gholdengo super effectively (Rock > Steel), Ceruledge super effectively (Rock > Fire/Ghost... wait, Ceruledge is Fire/Ghost, Rock hits both? No, Rock is neutral to Fire and Ghost). Actually Rock is super effective against Fire. So Head Smash hits Ceruledge super effectively. It also hits Mimikyu super effectively (Rock > Ghost/Fairy... wait, Rock is neutral to Ghost, and Rock is not super effective against Fairy). Actually Rock is neutral to both Ghost and Fairy, so Head Smash is neutral on Mimikyu.

Arcanine-Hisui weaknesses: Water (2x), Ground (2x), Fighting (2x but Chople Berry reduces to 1x). So Rotom-Wash is dangerous (Hydro Pump), Kingambit's Fighting moves (Close Combat) are reduced.

Gholdengo: Good against Kingambit (resists Dark, Steel hits), Mimikyu (resists Fairy, Steel hits). Nasty Plot makes it a sweeper. Weak to Ground (Rotom-Wash can't hit it with Ground since it's Levitate), Fighting.

Corviknight: Defensive pivot, resists many types. Can handle Dragapult somewhat (resists Dragon, hits with Iron Head). But slow.

Rotom-Wash: Will-O-Wisp cripples physical attackers (Kingambit, Arcanine, Ceruledge, Mimikyu). Good against Kingambit (Water hits Steel). Can handle Dragapult somewhat.

Clefable: Calm Mind sweeper, unaware ignores stat changes. Good against Dragapult (Fairy hits Dragon). But weak to Steel types.

Dragapult: Extremely fast, hits hard. Good against Gholdengo (Ghost hits), Kingambit (Dragon hits), Mimikyu (Ghost hits). But weak to many types.

I think the best combination would be:

Option 1: Arcanine-Hisui, Gholdengo, Corviknight
- Arcanine handles Kingambit, Gholdengo, Ceruledge
- Gholdengo handles Mimikyu, Kingambit
- Corviknight is a defensive pivot

Option 2: Arcanine-Hisui, Gholdengo, Rotom-Wash
- Arcanine handles Kingambit, Gholdengo, Ceruledge
- Gholdengo handles Mimikyu, Kingambit
- Rotom-Wash handles physical attackers with Will-O-Wisp, handles Kingambit

Option 3: Gholdengo, Arcanine-Hisui, Clefable
- Gholdengo handles Mimikyu, Kingambit
- Arcanine handles Kingambit, Gholdengo, Ceruledge
- Clefable handles Dragapult, Kingambit

Option 4: Dragapult, Gholdengo, Arcanine-Hisui
- Dragapult handles Gholdengo, Kingambit, Mimikyu
- Gholdengo handles Mimikyu, Kingambit
- Arcanine handles Kingambit, Gholdengo, Ceruledge

I think Arcanine-Hisui is a must-include given Chople Berry (protects from Close Combat from Kingambit) and Head Smash's raw power. It covers Kingambit, Gholdengo, and Ceruledge extremely well.

For the second slot, Gholdengo covers Mimikyu well (resists Fairy, Steel is super effective) and can also handle Kingambit defensively.

For the third slot, I need to handle Dragapult. Options:
- Corviknight: resists Dragon, can tank hits, but slow
- Clefable: Fairy hits Dragon super effectively, Calm Mind can sweep
- Rotom-Wash: Will-O-Wisp helps, but doesn't hit Dragapult super effectively
- Dragapult: speed tie, but risky

I think Corviknight is the best defensive option to handle Dragapult (resists Dragon, has Iron Head for neutral damage, Roost for recovery). It also provides Defog which is useful.

Actually, let me reconsider. Clefable with Calm Mind could sweep if it gets a setup turn. It resists Dragon (neutral actually, Fairy resists Dragon? No, Fairy is not resistant to Dragon. Dragon is neutral against Fairy). Wait, Dragon-type moves against Fairy: Dragon is not very effective against Fairy. Yes! Dragon is 0.5x against Fairy. So Clefable resists Dragon moves. And Fairy is super effective against Dragon. So Clefable has a great matchup against Dragapult.

But Clefable is weak to Steel (Gholdengo, Kingambit) and Poison. If Arcanine handles those, Clefable could work.

Let me go with: Arcanine-Hisui, Gholdengo, Corviknight

Actually, I'm worried about Dragapult. Corviknight resists Dragon but is slow (87 Spe vs up to 213). Dragapult can just U-Turn out or hit with something else.

Let me reconsider: Arcanine-Hisui, Gholdengo, Clefable
- Arcanine: handles Kingambit, Gholdengo, Ceruledge
- Gholdengo: handles Mimikyu, Kingambit
- Clefable: handles Dragapult, Kingambit (resists Dark), can Calm Mind sweep

The weakness is Rotom-Wash (Water hits Arcanine super effectively, and Rotom-Wash can Volt Switch). But Gholdengo resists Electric and is neutral to Water. Corviknight would be better against Rotom-Wash.

I'll go with: Arcanine-Hisui, Gholdengo, Corviknight

I'll go with Arcanine-Hisui, Gholdengo, Corviknight. This seems like the best balance of offense and defense.
